value.answer: Call 911 now. Swelling of the lips and face, hives and a hoarse voice after peanuts is an emergency. If you have an epinephrine auto-injector, use it right away and don't wait to see if it passes. Keep them lying down and stay with them.
value.triage: Call 911 now - this is not a job for 811. Antihistamines are not a substitute for epinephrine. Even if they look better, they still need the ER, because symptoms can come back.
